_notes: Swap-appliance manifest for the gas fuel-switching section. Not a load profile: entries carry annual THERMS and a 12-value monthly_shape (fraction of annual per calendar month, no hourly dimension — gas billing has no time-of-day component). Every monthly_shape sums to 1.0. `electric_replacement_profile` names a profile in profiles/index.json. A `conversion` block (heating, water-heater) derives the electric kWh from the entered therms; its absence (stove) means the electric side defaults to the replacement profile's own annual_kwh. All annual_therms are unverified, editable defaults.

appliances.name: Gas stove / range
appliances.notes: Cooking is barely seasonal, so this is nearly flat across the year. No efficiency conversion — an electric range's kWh comes from the electric-range profile default, since cooking has no standardized gas-vs-electric efficiency ratio.

appliances.name: Gas furnace / space heating
appliances.notes: Winter-peaked, near-zero in summer. 300 therms/yr suits a mild-climate home; a colder inland or mountain household runs higher. Conversion: an 80%-efficient furnace's delivered heat met by a COP-3.0 heat pump.

appliances.name: Gas water heater
appliances.notes: Mild winter bump from colder incoming water. Conversion: a 60%-efficient storage gas tank's delivered heat met by a COP-3.5 heat-pump water heater.

appliances.name: Other gas use (dryer, fireplace, pool heater, etc.)
appliances.notes: Not swappable — included only so the current gas bill reconciles with a real one. No electric_replacement_profile, no swap card.
